newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Securities jumps on injection hope.
newsitem.headline: Asia Securities jumps on injection hope.

text.p: Shares of Asia Securities International Ltd surged on asset injection hopes fuelled by rumours that a Chinese enterprise was considering taking a stake in the company, brokers said on Tuesday.
"The rumour has fuelled speculation of a possible future asset injection and that aided buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Asia Securities shares were up HK$0.40 to HK$2.15 at late morning trade on volume of 6.25 million shares worth HK$13.48 million.
Brokers said it is rumoured that China National Foreign Trade Transportation Corp, a unit of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, was considering taking a stake in Asia Securities.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Earlier this month, Asia Securities agreed to buy a 33 percent interest in a Shenzhen port developer and operator venture from China National Foreign Trade Transportation Corp for HK$220 million.
